text:
support-li: FYI customer reported Dedicated pool not scaling quickly enough -> clients seeing long 429/timeout window. They call it 'scale freeze' after a cold spike.
cs-jen: Customer: BrightCart production, model=gpt-open-32q, traffic burst ~1.2k rps for ~40s, observed >90s to add replicas and many requests queued.
support-li: Seen similar but want logs + repro. @ops-bot can you attach the autoscaler alert and recent events?
ops-bot: ALERT: autoscaler.scale_request_latency > 45s (avg 72s) for pool: dedicated-prod-us-west-2, events: 
- 3267894301 kube_event: PodScheduled pending imagePullBackOff
- 3267894310 autoscaler: scale_request queued due to attach.wait=120s
- 3267894335 attach: warmpool-attach timeout (handshake failed)
raj-eng: Can customer share exact curl pattern? and the model variant used on request (quantized vs fp16)?
cs-jen: Repro steps from BrightCart (copied):
1) start 1200 concurrent POST /v1/generate with prompt_size=512
2) set concurrency=1 per connection
3) after 30s ramp down -> many 429s during ramp up.
support-li: Thanks. logs from customer show repeated auth errors while pulling model:
```
WARN registry: token refresh failed: 401 unauthorized (rotation in progress)
ERR imagepull: failed to pull image: quota-exceeded
```
maria-sre: So two things: image pull/auth rotation causing pod create delays; and attach handshake failures causing warmpool not to cover ramp. Noisy neighbor GPU pressure noted on metrics (util 98% on node-nn-17).
tom-infra: Confirmed noisy tenant on same rack had a long-running high-alloc job -> GPU memory pressure causing kube to evict or throttle. Node had OOM tracker spikes at 3267894289.
raj-eng: Short-term mitigation: bump min_replicas to +2 for this customer and enable prefer_fallback_variant to quantized-8bit. Also increase attach timeout to 180s and warmpool size +1. Will that help?
cs-jen: Customer approved temp change.
support-li: Applied change: `PATCH /v1/pools/dedicated-prod` {"min_replicas":8,"warmpool":3,"attach_timeout_s":180,"fallback_variant":"gpt-open-32q-8bit"} -> ops-bot returned 202.
ops-bot: CONFIG UPDATE: pool dedicated-prod-us-west-2 updated by support-li @3267894420
raj-eng: Next steps: eng-infra to look at registry token rotation frequency and retry backoff, eng-sre to add eviction-aware placement to avoid noisy neighbor.
maria-sre: Action items: collect kube-scheduler events + node GPU utilization + attach RPC traces (attach.grpc trace_id=trc-3267894321).
support-li: @tom-infra can you pull the node metrics and confirm if there's a noisy tenant eviction window?
tom-infra: Pulling metrics: node-nn-17 GPU util spiked 98% from 3267894200->3267894360. Tenant id tenant-x42 had 3 long sessions. Will isolate and throttle.
raj-eng: Also spotted autoscaler logic: when attach fails due to imagepull/auth, we shouldn't count that towards attach.wait; proposing we add a fast-fail path and trigger fallback model earlier. Filing internal ticket INFRA-1298.
support-li: Customer reports latency improved after config change; still watching for remainder of day.
cs-jen: Customer asked for root cause summary and timeline for next-day postmortem.
support-li: Noted. I'll schedule a short postmortem with eng/infra/sre.
ops-bot: TICKET CREATED: INFRA-1298 assigned to tom-infra, raj-eng, priority=high
raj-eng: Quick note for repro: run `wrk -t8 -c1200 -d45s http://api.redwood/dedicated/prod/generate` with prompt_size 512 to reproduce scale-up window.
maria-sre: Add `kubectl get events --all-namespaces --since=2m` during repro for scheduler+attach errors.
support-li: Closing interim loop with customer, will reopen if they see recurrence. :thumbsup:
